# U.S. News Best Price Program

> > Trusted car shopping platform providing transparent pricing on new and used vehicles through TrueCar integration across major U.S. metropolitan markets.

U.S. News Best Price Program connects car buyers with competitive dealer pricing and extensive vehicle inventory, including certified pre-owned and electric vehicles. The platform serves major cities nationwide with tools for comparing prices, searching local inventory, and making informed car-buying decisions.

## Key Topics

- U.S. News Best Price Program
- TrueCar integration
- Used car listings
- Certified pre-owned vehicles
- Electric vehicle inventory
- Dealer pricing transparency
- Local vehicle search
- New car shopping
- Vehicle pricing tools
- Car buying vs leasing
- Major metro markets (Austin, Boston, Charlotte, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Detroit, Houston, Los Angeles)
- Nationwide dealer network
- Car shopping platform

## Core Car Shopping Tools

- [U.S. News Best Price Program](https://bestprice.cars.usnews.com/?linkto=registration&u1=nojs): TrueCar-powered car pricing program for new vehicle purchases
- [Used Cars for Sale Online Near Me](https://bestprice.cars.usnews.com/used-cars-for-sale/): Search nearly a million used car listings across major U.S. cities

## Electric Vehicle Inventory

- [Used Electric Cars for Sale Near Me](https://bestprice.cars.usnews.com/used-cars-for-sale/listings/fuel-electric/): Browse 10,000+ used electric vehicles with transparent pricing
